title: Bachelor Point
synopsis: Bachelor Point is a highly popular comedy-drama revolving around the everyday lives, friendships, struggles, and humorous experiences of a group of young men from different districts of Bangladesh living together in a shared apartment in Dhaka. It is celebrated for its authentic depiction of bachelor life and use of diverse regional dialects.
logline: Six bachelors. One apartment. Infinite chaos and heartwarming friendship.
concept: The idea stemmed from the relatable memories of bachelor life in Dhaka.
directorNote: Bachelor Point is not just a comedy. It's a love letter to every young man who ever ate cold rice alone and called it dinner.
inspiration: Inspired by personal experiences of bachelor life in Dhaka.
challenges: Coordinating with a large recurring cast across multiple seasons while maintaining the natural chemistry.
directorPerspective: This show taught me that simplicity is the highest form of complexity.

successStats.milestone: Most popular comedy series in Bangladesh
successStats.culturalImpact: Spawned countless memes, catchphrases ('Pasha Bhai', 'Kabila'), and massive fan communities.

title: Oshomoy
synopsis: The story follows Urbi, a university student from a middle-class background who becomes fascinated by the luxurious lives of her wealthy friends. As she navigates this world of privilege, she inadvertently becomes entangled in a homicide investigation. The film explores themes of societal show-off culture and the consequences of chasing material success.
logline: A poignant reflection on contemporary societal issues, double-faced lives, and unexpected tragedy.
concept: To showcase a different dimension of storytelling, breaking away from the pure comedy genre.
directorNote: Oshomoy was a challenge to myself to tell a story that makes people think deeply about the society we live in.
inspiration: The changing dynamics of modern society and unexpected turns in human lives.
challenges: Shifting audience expectations from pure comedy to serious drama.
directorPerspective: I wanted to prove that a storyteller is not bound by a single genre.

successStats.milestone: A critically acclaimed shift in genre for the director
successStats.culturalImpact: Praised for its realistic portrayal of society.

title: Hotel Relax
synopsis: The story follows a group of unusual individuals—including dacoits, cloth merchants, pickpockets, and conmen—who all gather at an infamous establishment called Hotel Relax. Their plan to rest unexpectedly leads to a series of chaotic and troublesome events in this comedy-thriller.
logline: Checking in is easy, relaxing is impossible when a diverse group of quirky characters collide.
concept: A situational comedy-thriller taking place in a single primary location.
directorNote: I wanted to create an ensemble piece where the location itself feels like a character.
inspiration: Classic locked-room mysteries blended with signature situational comedy.
challenges: Managing an ensemble cast in a confined space.
directorPerspective: The fun is in seeing how completely different personalities clash.

successStats.milestone: One of the most successful series on the Binge platform

title: Female 3
synopsis: The Female series revolves around the lives, misadventures, and humorous conflicts of a group of friends. It focuses on their interactions, gang dynamics, and comical situations while navigating life, relationships, and societal pressures in their neighborhood.
logline: The ultimate neighborhood rivalry continues with higher stakes and bigger laughs.
concept: To expand on the immensely popular 'Female' franchise with higher stakes and bigger laughs.
directorNote: It's always a joy returning to these characters. The audience's love for them makes the hard work worth it.
challenges: Matching the sky-high expectations set by the previous two installments.

successStats.milestone: Shattered previous viewership records for single dramas
